title: Dynamic Load Model for Data Centers with Pattern-Consistent Calibration
abstract: arXiv:2602.07859v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The rapid growth of large-scale data centers has made accurate dynamic data center load modeling increasingly important for power system analysis. Such loads are characterized by fast workload-driven variability and protection-driven disconnection and reconnection behavior that are not captured by conventional load models. Existing approaches to data center load modeling include physics-based methods, which provide interpretable structure for grid simulation, and data-driven approaches, which capture empirical workload variability from data. However, physics-based models are typically uncalibrated to facility-level operation, while trajectory alignment in data-driven methods often leads to overfitting and unrealistic dynamic behavior. To resolve these limitations, we design the framework to leverage both physics-based structure and data-driven adaptability. translated_title: 具有模式一致校准的数据中心动态负荷模型
translated_abstract: 大规模数据中心的快速增长使得精确的数据中心动态负荷建模对电力系统分析日益重要。此类负荷具有由工作负载驱动的快速变化特性，以及由保护机制触发的断开与重新连接行为，这些特性是传统负荷模型无法捕捉的。现有的数据中心负荷建模方法包括基于物理的方法和基于数据的方法：前者可为电网仿真提供可解释的结构，后者能够从数据中捕捉经验性的工作负载波动。然而，基于物理的模型通常未针对设施级运行进行校准，而数据驱动方法中的轨迹对齐往往导致过拟合和不切实际的动态行为。为解决这些局限，我们设计了同时利用基于物理的结构和数据驱动适应性的框架。我们进一步表明，轨迹级对齐方法对于本质上具有随机性的负荷而言是有限的（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 提出了一种融合物理模型可解释结构与数据驱动适应性的数据中心动态负荷建模框架，通过模式一致的校准方式避免了传统轨迹对齐方法带来的过拟合与不真实动态行为问题。
en_tdlr: A dynamic data center load modeling framework that combines physics-based structure with data-driven adaptability, using pattern-consistent calibration to avoid the overfitting and unrealistic dynamics caused by trajectory-level alignment.
